**Coaching Note:** Look for undefended pieces attacked by your pieces. After Nxd4, White's rook on e2 is attacked and undefended. If White recaptures with cxd4, you have tactical chances. If White moves the rook to safety, the bishop on d2 becomes undefended and your rook on b2 wins it. Always scan your opponent's pieces for defenders—an undefended piece under attack is a gift.
